method: sqlite3 -readonly with PRAGMA busy_timeout/query_only; original scoped audit derived canonical keys from v4_closed_loops.path_symbols_json and runtime rows, then a follow-up scoped query revalidated directed-symbol, Y/Z-group and physical loop_key coverage

findings.summary: Mainnet has 192 directed closed loops but only 96 runtime rows; the existing runtime keys use anchor|sorted(Y,Z) symbol groups, while closed-loop loop_key values are address paths.
findings.impact: A runtime row cannot uniquely represent both directed routes when Y-Z direction affects selected pools, preflight, review, PnL or broadcast identity. Direct physical loop_key matching also fails for every runtime row.
findings.requiredFix: Introduce a route-specific runtime identity that preserves direction and address/path identity; do not accept sorted-symbol group coverage as one-to-one coverage.

findings.summary: Counting v4_closed_loop_runtime_state without network/chain/protocol/market filters included one Testnet row.
findings.impact: Unscoped counts can misstate mainnet coverage and produce an invalid missing/orphan conclusion.
findings.requiredFix: Every runtime coverage audit must require an explicit scope and report out-of-scope rows separately.

corrections.currentFinding: scoped runtime=96, exact directed matched=96, exact directed missing=96, canonical group missing=0, out-of-scope runtime=1

notes: This report is a read-only audit snapshot, not a production acceptance result.
